changes.reason: Reduce projectability freezing threshold to avoid over-constraining the subspace; frontier runs show 0.85 gives best results (~25 meV)
Keep current exclusion threshold (different from frontier's 0.01-0.02) to maintain permissive state dropping while reducing freezing

diagnosis: The PDWF construction fails both dmft_subspace_model_window (918 meV vs 20 meV limit) and model_bands_correspond_to_parent_bands (0.274 vs 0.2 limit). The frontier's own runs show a clear pattern: dis_proj_max=0.99 (current) gives terrible results (208-918 meV), while dis_proj_max=0.85-0.9 gives the best results (~24-38 meV). The issue is that dis_proj_max=0.99 freezes too many states by projectability, over-constraining the subspace and preventing accurate representation of the entangled Mn 3d / O 2p target manifold. The model_bands_correspondence failure appeared only when dis_proj_max was raised to 0.99 (run 9), confirming this over-freezing. The best frontier runs (4 and 8) used dis_proj_max=0.85 with dis_proj_min=0.02 and 0.01 respectively. The current run uses dis_proj_min=0.005, so dis_proj_max=0.85 with dis_proj_min=0.005 is an untried combination that should reduce over-freezing while keeping the more permissive exclusion threshold.

model_bands_correspond_to_parent_bands.note: 0 of 11302 inside -6.47..15.42 eV sit further than 505 meV from any band the parent calculation has; bands 1-4 excluded by the deck and not counted (isolated 25.71 eV below the represented manifold)
